items.summary_zh: 波音 CEO Kelly Ortberg 表示，其华盛顿州伦顿工厂的机翼生产是一处拖累，并称公司已有应对计划。

items.title: Anthropic policy chief says AI companies can't be expected to operate on 'honor code'
items.title_zh: Anthropic 政策负责人称，不能指望 AI 公司靠“荣誉准则”运作
items.summary: Sarah Heck, Anthropic's head of public policy, offered her perspectives on AI safety as the debate about how to regulate model development intensifies.
items.summary_zh: 随着关于如何监管模型开发的争论升温，Anthropic 公共政策负责人 Sarah Heck 阐述了她对 AI 安全的看法。

items.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
items.title_zh: 众议院投票认定 Leon Black 藐视国会，因其拒绝服从爱泼斯坦案传票
items.summary: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.
items.summary_zh: 亿万富翁 Leon Black 正在起诉众议院监督与政府改革委员会，试图阻止该委员会在爱泼斯坦调查中向他发出的传票。

items.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles says she's cancer free
items.title_zh: 白宫幕僚长 Susie Wiles 称自己已无癌症
items.summary: Susie Wiles oversaw Trump’s winning 2024 presidential campaign and has wielded major influence in his second administration.
items.summary_zh: Susie Wiles 曾主导特朗普赢得 2024 年总统竞选，并在其第二个任期内拥有重大影响力。

items.title: Hyperscaler debt signals warning sign, Apollo cautions
items.title_zh: Apollo 警告：超大规模云厂商债务释放警示信号
items.summary: Credit default swaps for companies building data centers are getting pricier, and it's not because banks are hedging more of their bets.
items.summary_zh: 为建设数据中心的企业提供的信用违约互换正在变贵，而这并不是因为银行增加了对冲。

items.title: Continental Resources to develop massive oil patch in Venezuela
items.title_zh: Continental Resources 将在委内瑞拉开发大型油田
items.summary: Continental said it undertook an "independent evaluation of opportunities" in Venezuela after President Donald Trump called for the industry to invest.
items.summary_zh: Continental 表示，在总统特朗普呼吁该行业进行投资之后，公司对委内瑞拉的机会进行了“独立评估”。

items.title: Hegseth avoids impeachment vote with early House election recess
items.title_zh: 众议院提前进入选举休会期，Hegseth 避开弹劾投票
items.summary: The House won't take a vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after House leaders decided to leave Washington a day earlier than planned.
items.summary_zh: 在众议院领导人决定比原计划提前一天离开华盛顿后，众议院将不会就弹劾国防部长 Pete Hegseth 进行投票。

items.title: American Airlines says 30% of seats drive half of revenue as premium cabin rush heats up
items.title_zh: 美国航空称 30% 的座位贡献了一半营收，高端舱位需求升温
items.summary: American says a minority of its seats now accounts for half of its revenue.
items.summary_zh: 美国航空表示，其少数座位如今贡献了一半营收。
